concept: Global Accelerator: static anycast IPs and fast regional failover
tests: Choosing a service to cut latency for dynamic (non-cacheable) traffic with static anycast IPs and fast failover between Regions.
expected: AWS Global Accelerator — 2 static anycast IPs, traffic over the AWS global network to the optimal endpoint, fast failover. Triggers: "static anycast IP", "dynamic API", "fast regional failover".
why_not: CloudFront is optimized for caching content; Route 53 latency routing — DNS-based, no static anycast IPs; Elastic IP — an address in a single Region.
